texts.zh:
定向扫描发现[root.capital_scope.GetName]地表下埋藏着精密设施，且越靠近核心处，设施的规模越大，复杂度越高。它们的材质和能量特征与我们首次苏醒时的休眠舱一致。

这些必定是我们前文明的遗迹。若能进入这些设施，或许解答关于我们过去的最大谜团：我们是谁？经历了什么？
texts.en:
Targeted scans have found evidence of sophisticated facilities buried beneath the surface of [root.capital_scope.GetName], increasing in size and complexity as they approach the core. Their material and energy signatures match those of the stasis chamber where we first awoke.

These must be remnants of our previous civilization. If we can access these facilities, we may find answers to the greatest questions about our past: who are we, and what happened to us?

notes.zh: 开局时母星人口被削减为沉眠，居民在休眠舱中；项目“钻探地壳”完成后2505“更多族人苏醒”开始局势“深挖”。
notes.en: At start six pop groups are dead and five stasis pods wait on the homeworld; the Drilling the Crust project leads to 2505 More Kin Awaken, which starts the situation Deep Excavation.

texts.zh: 要弄清我们是谁，首先要知道我们来自哪里。我们需要挖掘埋在[owner.Capital.GetName]地表下的设施。
texts.en: If we want to understand who we are, we must first learn where we came from. We'll need to excavate the facilities buried beneath the surface of [owner.Capital.GetName].

texts.zh:
许多隐藏的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]族群可能像我们曾经那样散布在银河系中，以冻存形式保存着。

档案记录了这些星球的位置，但自那时起已有整颗恒星诞生与消亡，要定位它们现在需要复杂的插值法。
texts.en:
Numerous hidden [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] populations may be scattered across the galaxy, preserved in stasis as we once were.

The archives recorded these worlds' positions, but with entire stars born and lost since, locating them now requires complex interpolation.

texts.zh: 挖掘揭露了地下设施，其中藏有先进科技、档案数据和更多沉睡亲族的休眠舱。我们的历史就埋藏于此；若能挖掘全部，或许最终能明白自己是谁。
texts.en: Our excavation has revealed subterranean facilities housing advanced technology, archived data, and stasis pods containing more of our dormant kin. Our history itself is buried here; if we can dig it all up, we may finally understand who we are.

texts.en: We need to gain access to this facility, and the awakened sleepers are in our way. Remove them by force.

texts.zh: 若能令设施居民依赖我们，我们就能有筹码要求进入设施。应向他们大量供应实用且关键的物资与资源。
texts.en: If we can make the inhabitants of this facility dependent on us, we will have leverage to demand access to the facility. We should flood them with useful, critical goods and resources.

summary.text:
# 宇宙黎明 / Cosmic Dawn

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/infernals_1_events.txt:120-140,2411-2640`; `common/situations/13_infernal_situations.txt`
- DLC：Infernals Species Pack
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

“宇宙黎明”起源（origin_cosmic_dawn）：游戏开始1天后 infernals.10 → infernals.2500 弹出，发现首都地表下的休眠设施。

The Cosmic Dawn origin (origin_cosmic_dawn): one day after game start infernals.10 -> infernals.2500 fires, discovering the dormant facility under the capital.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

2500 → 专项“钻探地壳” → 2505“更多亲族苏醒”（授权全面挖掘 / 仅必要 / 外包）→ 情势“深层挖掘” → 阶段事件 2510 失忆与数据 → 2515 生命维持失败 → 2540 远古监狱 → 强攻（专项 → 2545）或贿赂（专项 → 2550） → 2555 悲剧事故（四个应对，7天后 2560/2565/2570/2575）；2515 另在4个月后引出 2520“星际避难所”，启动事件链“星际避难所”。情势走满时 2580“历史揭晓”。

2500 -> project "Drill through the crust" -> 2505 "More kin awake" (authorise full excavation / only what is needed / outsource) -> situation "Deep Excavation" -> stage events 2510 Amnesia and Data -> 2515 Life Support Failure -> 2540 Ancient Prison -> storm (project -> 2545) or bribe (project -> 2550) -> 2555 Tragic Accident (four responses, 2560/2565/2570/2575 seven days later); 2515 also leads four months later to 2520 "Stellar Refuge", starting the event chain "Stellar Refuge". When the situation completes, 2580 "History Revealed".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

强攻 / 贿赂；事故的四种应对；2580 的四个选项决定如何对待遗产（重建帝国、要求尊重、着眼未来、行善）。

Storm / bribe; four responses to the accident; the four options of 2580 decide how to treat the legacy (rebuild the empire, demand respect, look to the future, do good).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

部分选项要求特定资源或政体。

Some options need specific resources or governments.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了情势、阶段事件、专项与事件链；原先与红巨星混在一张卡里，现拆为独立故事。该起源属 C1。

Situation, stage events, projects and the event chain were checked; it was previously mixed with Red Giant in one card and is now its own story. The origin belongs to C1.
